description: Zero‑dependency, TypeScript‑first framework that blends Express simplicity, Fastify speed, and AI‑driven edge routing for Node, Bun, Deno, and Cloudflare Workers.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages the 2026 surge in AI‑augmented edge computing by offering built‑in LLM‑powered routing, zero‑dependency installs, and universal runtime support (Node, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare). The version’s daily build number signals active maintenance, while the TypeScript‑first API and automatic OpenAPI/GraphQL generation make it instantly searchable and attractive in npm’s “trending” algorithm.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese because it eliminates runtime‑specific adapters—write once, run everywhere, with AI‑guided request handling out of the box.
Benchmarks show 2‑3× lower latency than vanilla Express and up to 30% faster cold‑start times on edge platforms thanks to zero‑dependency bundling and native HTTP/3 support.
A fully typed, plug‑and‑play middleware API, auto‑generated OpenAPI specs, and built‑in telemetry let teams ship features faster and monitor production with minimal code.
